records.measurement_note: OpenCV LSD on the actual new alpha-masked PNG, verified with enlarged whole-image and end/pier overlays. The curved stone arch is an arch, not a ground-parallel line. Raised piers and cap top/middle/lower straight edges are independently checked. Full-height post corners also use horizontal Sobel ridge samples and Huber fits across their visible upright intervals, excluding projecting ledges; this prevents upper/lower-only checks from hiding an overall leaning post.

Actual forest source pixels at post-cap bases, shaft frieze, opposite plinth courses and upright edges. Sloping pyramid roofs/organic ivy are excluded.

exemptions.reason: Organic silhouettes and curved/broken fragments have no rectangular horizontal axes. Actors can face arbitrary directions. Roof inclines and stair lengths change height and are not horizontal-axis edges. Source-only beacons are not instantiated.
